newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria Leykam says KNP Leykam open to cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Austria Leykam says KNP Leykam open to cooperation.

text.p: Austrian paper maker Leykam-Muerztaler AG, part of Dutch KNP BT, said on Wednesday its KNP Leykam subsidiary was open to cooperation but was not up for sale.

Leykam chief executive Wolfgang Pfarl told Reuters the firm was exploring ways of "concentrating" its business but he declined to comment on a press report that Sweden's Stora was poised to make a bid for KNP Leykam.
"KNP Leykam is not up for sale but it is open to cooperation," Pfarl said.
"This may lead to KNP Leykam becoming involved in a cooperation, or even a merger, with another company," he continued.
A Stora spokesman in Sweden dismissed the report.
Pfarl forecast little improvement in already tough paper market conditions over the next two to three years. "There has to be a concentration," he said.
KNP BT announced in September that it was halting fresh investment in KNP Leykam and would seek a partner for the loss-making paper producer.
KNP BT owns a 72 percent stake in Leykam-Muerztaler and a 69.5 percent stake in KNP Leykam. Leykam-Muerztaler controls 30.5 percent of KNP Leykam.
On Wednesday Leykam-Muerztaler shares closed steady in Vienna at 317 schillings.
